title: Loeb's artificial light-sail theory of 'Oumuamua

tellings.quote: All of the proposals that were put on the table to explain the anomalies of Oumuamua invoked a rock of a type that we've never seen before.
All the proposals that were put on the table to explain the anomalies of Amua Mua invoked a rock of a type that we've never seen before.
tellings.link_reason: This is Loeb's own statement that every natural explanation of 'Oumuamua's anomalies needs a rock of a type never seen before. The quote is nearly identical.

as_told.title: Avi Loeb on the anomalies of Oumuamua

plain: The Harvard scientist Avi Loeb argues that 'Oumuamua, an object that passed through our solar system from interstellar space in 2017, may be an artificial light sail: a thin, built sheet pushed along by sunlight. On two visits years apart, Loeb says that every natural explanation put forward for its odd behaviour "invoked a rock of a type that we've never seen before", which to him makes a made object the simpler answer; he credits the case to his book Extraterrestrial. If he is right, it would be a piece of alien technology seen passing by Earth.
